description: K-beauty products that cost less at another U.S.-dollar store — same product and same size only, biggest savings first (up to 10). Optionally narrow by a brand or product word, or a category (sunscreen, serum, toner, essence, moisturizer, cleanser, mask, eye, lip, body). Prices are the stores' own, checked daily, before coupons and shipping. Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA), plus rules for 7 more export markets say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
